passive.name: Clockwork Windup
passive.description: Orianna's Attacks deal additional magic damage. This damage increases the more Orianna Attacks the same target.

primaryAbilities.name: Command: Attack
primaryAbilities.description: Orianna commands her Ball to fire toward a target location, dealing magic damage to targets along the way (deals less damage to subsequent targets). Her Ball remains at the target location after.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Orianna commands her <keywordMajor>Ball</keywordMajor> to move to an area, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage</magicDamage> to surrounding enemies and to enemies it passes through. Deals {{ reduceddamagepercent }}% less damage to all enemies after the first.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Command: Dissonance
primaryAbilities.description: Orianna commands her Ball to release a pulse of energy, dealing magic damage around it. This leaves a field behind that speeds up allies and slows enemies.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Orianna commands her Ball to release an electric pulse, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to surrounding enemies.

The pulse leaves behind an energy field for {{ fieldduration }} seconds, Slowing enemies by {{ slowamount*100 }}% and granting allies {{ hasteamount*100 }}% Move Speed, decaying over {{ slowandhasteduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Command: Protect
primaryAbilities.description: Orianna commands her Ball to attach to an allied champion, Shielding them and dealing magic damage to any enemies it passes through on the way. Additionally, the Ball grants additional Armor and Magic Resist to the champion it is attached to.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Passive: The Ball adds {{ defensebonus }} Armor and {{ defensebonus }} Magic Resist to the allied champion it is attached to.

Active: Orianna commands her Ball to attach to an allied champion, granting them {{ totalshieldtooltip }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. Enemies the Ball passes through take {{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Command: Shockwave
primaryAbilities.description: Orianna commands her Ball to unleash a shockwave, dealing magic damage and launching nearby enemies towards the Ball after a short delay.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Orianna commands her <keywordMajor>Ball</keywordMajor> to unleash a shockwave, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies and <status>Knocking</status> them in the direction of the <keywordMajor>Ball</keywordMajor>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
